payload.question: Are people happy after they contact the council?
payload.label: Satisfaction with the customer contact team, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: This asks people who contacted the customer contact team. It does not tell you what people who never got through think. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council asks people who contact its customer team whether they were satisfied. It aims for 77% and says it will step in below 69.3%. In the first quarter of 2025/26, 79.37% said they were satisfied.
